title.en: Pricing group fields and influencer quota prechecks
title.zh: 定价分组字段与达人创作余额预检

summary.en: `GET /api/pricing` now publishes `pricing_version` plus per-model `default_group` and `group_order`. Influencer character, multiview and video creation check the account balance before enqueue and fail closed when quota is insufficient.
summary.zh: `GET /api/pricing` 新增 `pricing_version`、模型级 `default_group` 与 `group_order`。达人角色、多视图与视频创作在入队前校验账户余额，余额不足时直接拦截。

body.en:
## Pricing API display fields

`GET /api/pricing` now returns the top-level `pricing_version` value `"model-group-display-v1"`. Every model row also carries `default_group`, the server-selected default group, and `group_order`, the de-duplicated display order covering all of the model's `enable_groups`. Use these fields instead of deriving a default group from `enable_groups` locally.

## Influencer creation quota prechecks

`POST /api/influencer/v1/characters`, `POST /api/influencer/v1/characters/{task_id}/multiview` and `POST /api/influencer/v1/videos` check the account balance before the task enters the queue. Insufficient balance returns `403` with `code: "insufficient_user_quota"` and `message: "Insufficient user quota"`; no task is created, nothing is charged and no upstream call is made. If the pricing or quote service is unavailable, the response is `503` with `code: "generation_quote_unavailable"`. Tasks that run out of balance during execution or settlement expose `fail_reason: "Insufficient user quota"`. Recharge in the workbench and retry the same request to continue.
body.zh:
## 定价 API 展示字段

`GET /api/pricing` 新增顶层 `pricing_version`，当前值为 `"model-group-display-v1"`。每个模型行同时返回服务端下发的默认分组 `default_group` 与去重且覆盖该模型全部 `enable_groups` 的展示顺序 `group_order`；客户端无需自行从 `enable_groups` 推导默认分组。

## 达人创作余额预检

`POST /api/influencer/v1/characters`、`POST /api/influencer/v1/characters/{task_id}/multiview` 和 `POST /api/influencer/v1/videos` 在任务入队前校验账户余额。余额不足返回 `403`，`code: "insufficient_user_quota"`、`message: "Insufficient user quota"`，不创建任务、不扣费、不发起上游调用。计价/报价服务暂不可用时返回 `503`，`code: "generation_quote_unavailable"`。任务在执行或结算阶段因余额不足失败时公开 `fail_reason: "Insufficient user quota"`；在工作台充值后可重试同一请求继续。
